task:
FIX TWO CODEX REVIEW FINDINGS ON PR #819 (purge P2b1), review round 4. Branch codex/run-38735057403-1 at 3765729240b4e8c5c2d9cebf297f4b2cb70b91ce. Change nothing else; do not weaken tests.

F1 (script identity must cover every executed module): scripts/operator/lib/v3_generation_purge.py computes script_sha256 over a file set that omits scripts/operator/lib/f2d_evidence.py, which it loads via _load('f2d_evidence') and uses to validate plan and verification seals. Include every module the purge action executes (f2d_evidence.py, v3_purge_state.py, v3_purge_transactions.py, v3_generation_purge.py, the action .sh) in that digest, in a fixed sorted order, so a modified helper changes script_sha256 and the authorize source/script comparison fails closed. Add a test that changing f2d_evidence.py bytes changes the digest.

F2 (temp files placement): when temp_tablespaces is empty, PostgreSQL writes temporary files to the database's default tablespace (pg_database.dattablespace), not necessarily pg_default. The plan's placement gate currently assumes the data-directory device in that case. Resolve the database default tablespace (and, when it is not pg_default/pg_global, its location via pg_tablespace_location) and require its device to equal the data-directory device; if it cannot be proven, stop the plan with tablespace_or_wal_filesystem_mismatch. Add tests for: empty temp_tablespaces with dattablespace = pg_default (passes), empty temp_tablespaces with a non-default dattablespace on another device (stops).

Run: ruff check .; bash -n scripts/operator/actions/v3-derived-generation-purge.sh; python -m pytest -q tests/test_v3_derived_generation_purge_operator.py tests/test_v3_purge_transactions.py tests/test_v3_governed_derived_purge.py tests/test_f2d_operator_identity.py; python scripts/operator/v3_production_deploy.py --operation authority-gate; the Semgrep command from .github/workflows/semgrep.yml. Allowed files: those already changed by this PR. End with files changed and tests run with counts.
